name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Manga-styled group of buttons and inputs joined in one row or column. Shared edges collapse to one 2px line; the outer corners follow the radius. A ButtonGroupSeparator is an ink rule (2px, no tone) between two buttons. ButtonGroupText is a label cell in the same frame. Works with the kit Button and Input. Vertical orientation is supported. The focused button draws its ring inside itself, never over a neighbour. Gestures: the buttons keep their own G3 hover, G4 impact and focus.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/button-group". It wraps your own components/ui/button-group. Put the manga Button (or Input) inside. Use ButtonGroupSeparator between two buttons that should show a rule instead of a shared edge.

meta.tagline: Buttons joined by one shared 2px line, like a strip of cells.
meta.usage:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"
import { ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupSeparator } from "@/components/ui/manga/button-group"

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Pages">
  <Button variant="outline">Prev</Button>
  <ButtonGroupSeparator />
  <Button variant="outline">Next</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

props.name: orientation
props.description: Row (default) or column; the shared line follows it.

props.name: ButtonGroupSeparator
props.description: An ink rule between two items. orientation vertical (default) in a row, horizontal in a column.

props.name: ButtonGroupText
props.description: A label cell in the frame (paper, lettering).
